observations.question: What are the Aurora Silver room-rent terms for hospitalization?
observations.answer_preview: Under the Aurora Silver plan, the room-rent limit is 2% of the sum insured per day [1][3]. If you occupy a room exceeding this 2% limit, proportionate deduction applies, meaning Aurora reduces all associated charges—such as surgeon fees, anaesthetist, nursing, and operation theatre charges—in the same proportion [5].
